source: Existing ordinary SGD states; new unseen branch outcomes, not new independent initializations
model: fixed activation patterns, evolving bilinear coefficient-feature feedback, original cross-entropy
primary_target: seed-level mean reserve-minus-ordinary gain over independent streams
quantitative_hypothesis: Effect RMSE less than 0.35 times zero-effect RMSE over the pooled primary settings, and consistent sign for material effects
sign_hypothesis: Slower feedback usually hurts after early learning on MNIST
ordinary_gain_forecast: Secondary comparison with frozen-linear-response model; no assumed improvement
scope: A local response-transport model, not a prediction of entire training or proof that delayed commitment causes the MNIST width gap
